notes.title: Turtle Champs 1.1
notes.content:
There has been some quality of life features added to the game along with bug fixes.

-Firstly, there is now a large compass on the players screen to easily find the ball.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061061/bcc6220f56904adf6780be261912b4ab31d70432.png[/img]

-As you might have noticed, the ball is now an orange color instead of green. The highlight outline of the ball will now shrink as the ball gets further from the player.



-Next is the practice range. In here, there are no goals, just shoot the ball around as much as you like.
-While you have the pause menu up, it always displays the game settings. But now you can click these to change the setting while in game. This feature is only available while in the practice range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061061/dd0625a5afa14b079e2528b1becc73e20011fca8.png[/img]

-There are also many bug fixes.



Stay turned for more updates in the future, and feel free to leave suggestions as these were all community ideas.
